newsitem.title: USA: Shaw sees Q2 results below expectations.
newsitem.headline: Shaw sees Q2 results below expectations.

text.p: Shaw Industries Inc Wednesday said second quarter results will be below expectations due to slower-than-expected residential replacement sales/

In a statement, the company said sales for the second quarter will be about $915 million, four percent below expectations, and earnings will be about $0.16 a share, below analysts' estimates of approximately $0.21 a share.
Residential replacement sales were slower than expected in the first half of the quarter. Sales levels have improved since the middle of May, but not enough to offset a slow start, the company said.
Shaw manufactures and sells carpeting and rugs throughout the United States, the United Kingdom, Australia and Mexico, and exports to Canada and many other countries.
